description: This file is a C header file defining internal API function prototypes for the Slap Var Mapper object within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) component of the RDK project. It declares functions related to internal state management, syntax initialization, content type setup, and variable mapping operations.

methods.name: SlapVmoReset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the Slap Var Mapper object.

methods.name: SlapVmoInitAtoSyntax
methods.description: Initializes the syntax configuration for the internal object.

methods.name: SlapVmoInitAtoContentType
methods.description: Initializes the content type settings for the internal object.

methods.name: SlapVmoGetVarSyntax
methods.description: Retrieves the syntax type of a variable based on its name.

methods.name: SlapVmoGetVarContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the content type of a variable based on its name.
